talk_note: talk is a low-reliability signal (keyword search, no entity match, Reddit/Mastodon often unavailable): weight stays 2 (mirrored in web/method.json and data/config.json; lower it in all three together if measuring shows noise), cap lowered 500 -> 150 because Bluesky/HN counts per story are small.
note: score = 100 * sum(w_i * x_i) / sum(w_i) * 0.5^(age_h / half_life_h); every x_i in 0..1 (saturating log of the raw count / cap). A signal with no data counts as 0, never as an average. Tune only after measuring.

reddit.note: search.json is 403 from datacentre IPs; RSS used, flaky (429), posts only

mastodon.note: only runs when the token env var is set; unauthenticated search is always empty

x.note: X/Twitter has no free public search API (paid tier). Stub only: fetchX() returns null. To enable, implement it in pipeline/discuss.mjs against a paid key and flip this flag.
